name: Quantum Computing
description: Tracks quantum-computing hardware results from primary sources for security briefings: a qubits-versus-error landscape with cryptanalytic resource estimates, current records with dataset-version changes, all results in a lookback window, and the gap between today's devices and published estimates, compared like for like.

shortcuts.name: Quantum Landscape
shortcuts.description: Physical qubits against error rate, with resource-estimate curves for a cryptographically relevant quantum computer (CRQC).

shortcuts.name: Quantum Records
shortcuts.description: Current best result on each quantum hardware metric.

shortcuts.name: Quantum Devices
shortcuts.description: Quantum hardware results in a lookback window, by modality.

shortcuts.name: Quantum Estimates
shortcuts.description: Resource estimates for a cryptographically relevant quantum computer (CRQC), and the gap to today's devices.
